validation.message: kick animation must enable DamageEmitter monitoring during the kick and disable it when the kick ends

solver.message:
Implemented the standing kick across the three requested files.

- [character.gd](/workspace/scenes/characters/character.gd:17): Added `State.KICK` and its `"kick"` animation mapping.
- [player.gd](/workspace/scenes/characters/player.gd:18): Attacking while walking enters `KICK` and immediately stops ground movement. Attacking while idle still punches.
- [player.tscn](/workspace/scenes/characters/player.tscn:117): Added a 0.3-second kick using all six valid fifth-row frames, **40–45**. `DamageEmitter.monitoring` turns on at 0.1 seconds and off at completion. The existing `on_action_complete` callback returns the player to idle.

Verified in **Godot 4.4.1**: attack selection, movement stopping and resuming, all six frames, damage timing, completion, and existing airborne jumpkick behavior. The main scene also passed a 60-frame smoke run. Visually reviewed the [captured kick sequence](/workspace/.godot/kick_frames.png).
